title: TMAL: Topology-preserving Multi-offset Affinity Learning for Curvilinear Structure Segmentation
mechanism: Predict soft directional affinities at several pixel offsets, fuse them with decoder-derived spatial weights, decode to an inverted distance map and threshold; auxiliary mask branch keeps overlap accuracy.
adaptation: Published target (inverted EDT) is degenerate on 1-2 px cracks (every crack px has EDT 1). Replace with a Gaussian tube around the label skeleton (sigma about 1 px, the measured jitter) and build affinities as products of tube values at offsets s in {1,2}, so links bridge a 1 px gap. Crack channels only on the house encoder; 24-class CE head kept; crack read-out = TMAL map as crack logit or threshold chosen on val. Code link from abstract (github.com/suho-han/TMAL) not found by web search.
min_experiment: Arm PF + TMAL crack branch vs PF, cv5v2 2 seeds x 5 folds then 5 seeds test; control with s={1} only (DconnNet-like); metric components >=20 px found and relF1@2, width ratio and strict IoU guards; kill if components +<0.02 and relF1@2 +<0.01, or strict IoU down >0.01.
evidence: Full text read. Own 512 px protocol, baselines retrained: DeepCrack (300 train) IoU 0.743 vs DconnNet 0.713 vs U-Net 0.681, clDice 0.907 vs 0.893 vs 0.859, component error 1.98 vs 4.51 vs 4.93. DRIVE (20 train) IoU 0.709 vs 0.635, component error 24.5 vs 452.8. HD95 not best.
prior_overlap: none; connectivity outputs never run (DconnNet parked in T2 for cost)

alt_notes.adaptation: Crack-only affinity head on U-Net++ (offsets 1, 2, 4 px, 8 directions) fused with the seg branch; weight larger offsets more because 1 px offsets are dominated by label jitter.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PF + multi-offset affinity head; baseline PF; 3 seeds. Metric: CV components >= 20 px found, relF1@2, strict crack IoU. Kill if components found gain < +0.02 and IoU n.d.

alt_notes.adaptation: Affinity head for crack and gridline on U-Net++, offsets 1, 2 and 4 px so a 1 px jitter does not break the target; segmentation branch kept as is. Held by D09 / D12.
alt_notes.min_experiment: PF + TMAL head vs PF, 5 seeds. Kill if crack relF1@2 gain < 0.01 and component recall gain < 0.02.

alt_notes.adaptation: Crack-only affinity head on U-Net++ with offsets 1, 2, 4 px and 8 directions; weight larger offsets more because 1 px affinities inherit label jitter; fuse with the seg branch for the crack map.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PF + affinity head; baseline: PF; 3 seeds. Metric: CV crack components >= 20 px found, relF1@2, strict IoU. Kill if components-found gain < +0.02 and IoU n.d.

alt_notes.adaptation: Crack-only affinity head at offsets 1, 2, 4 px; larger offsets link pixels along the crack and should tolerate 1-2 px label jitter better than 1-px connectivity.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + multi-offset affinity head, 5 seeds; baseline house. Metrics: components found, crack relF1@2, E1 relF1@2. Kill: gains < 0.01 in-distribution and < 0.02 on E1.
